overall_assessment: Section splitting for NIH is accurate: all headings (Kort om emnet, Læringsutbytte, Læringsformer og aktiviteter, Arbeidskrav, Vurdering/eksamen) map cleanly, arbeidskrav land in coursework_requirements, and WISEflow/plagiarism notes are removed. The main weakness is the reading_list section, which is mostly a pointer or placeholder rather than an actual reading list, plus a Forkrav section that is sometimes not extracted.

findings.evidence: Ettersom vi er i en overgangsfase mellom to systemer viser vi til Studiehåndbok 2023-2024 for litteratur for emner studieåret 2023- 2024
findings.description: The reading_list row contains no literature: 2022-2023 plans carry a generic transition notice pointing to the study handbook archive, and 2024-2025 plans carry only 'Pensumlista for høsten 2025.' / 'Pensumliste for høsten 2024.'. These are pointers/placeholders emitted as real reading_list content (also the cause of the pre-pass 'long' flags, which are false alarms about length but correctly reflect repeated boilerplate). Downstream, reading_list is identical across many courses and carries no information.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The 'Kjernelitteratur' heading maps to reading_list and its whole body is kept without a content check in .clean_sections() in R/extract_sections.R.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections(), drop reading_list rows for nih matching '^Ettersom vi er i en overgangsfase', '^Pensumlist[ae] for (høsten|våren)' or '^Se emnearkivet' (or flag them as pointer-only) so the section is NA rather than boilerplate.

findings.description: Newer plans have a 'Forkrav' heading, but for these courses no prerequisites row was extracted (only course_content, learning_outcomes, teaching_methods, coursework_requirements, assessment, reading_list), while for nih_LKI230-1_2025_autumn_1 the same heading is correctly captured. The 'Hvem kan ta dette emnet?' admission block is not captured anywhere (and appears dropped, which is fine).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Likely .clean_sections() removes a prerequisites section that is only 'Ingen emner i programmet' (treated as placeholder), while the version with an additional sentence survives; inconsistent handling.
findings.suggested_fix: Decide a consistent rule in .clean_sections(): either keep short 'Ingen ...' prerequisites rows for all, or drop all; verify the Forkrav heading pattern in R/section_heading_map.R is applied identically.
